goal: VGGT-Omega hand-token overfit ablations: final-K depth sweep through first layer, compared with prior token-mode runs.

tasks_completed.summary: Submitted and monitored final-K K=8/12/16/20/24 one-manifest 200-step overfit jobs; all reached SUCCEEDED.
Collected old and new histories, generated a combined loss-curve figure, and published the comparison table/results.

discoveries.title: Final-K depth threshold
discoveries.body: K=2/4/6/8 consistently overfit on this 200-step surface, while K=16/20/24 fail. K=12 is partial/unstable: final loss drops to 0.0868 but last20 remains 0.4001 due spikes.

discoveries.title: First-layer final-K is not equivalent to successful shallow insertion
discoveries.body: K=24 inserts from block 0 / first layer and fails with last20 3.8823, close to layer0_oneway and auto/all-depth failures.

discoveries.title: K=8 remains in the overfit regime
discoveries.body: The new K=8 run reached final 0.0296 and last20 0.0324, comparable to K=2/4/6 and cross_attn_readonly.

module_state.state: K=8 pt-waadp8ia on p1 RESERVED; K=12/16/20/24 on share-space-01e SPOT after p1 quota rejection; all SUCCEEDED.
Remote histories under logs/vggt_omega/*finalk{8,12,16,20,24}*; published assets include combined_loss_curves.png and overfit_results_summary.json.
Runs use max_manifest_size=1 and match the prior E2 overfit command surface; this is a one-manifest surface, not a strict deterministic fixed-window proof.

tasks_pending.summary: Use final-K K=8 or smaller as the viable hand-token insertion window; avoid all-depth/first-layer bidirectional insertion unless adding stronger isolation or a different attention contract.
If a deterministic fixed-window claim is needed, rerun the chosen K values with a true fixed-window manifest/sampler instead of max_manifest_size=1.

caveats: K=12 has low final loss but high last20 because the curve spikes late; it should be treated as partial rather than a clean pass.
K=24 uses final-K bidirectional semantics from the first layer; layer0_oneway uses a one-way mask where native VGGT tokens cannot read hand tokens.
The comparison keeps the prior E2 command surface; it does not change optimizer groups or loss weights.

K=24 is the first-layer final-K condition and differs from layer0_oneway because native VGGT tokens can still attend hand tokens.
